_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — this file is public. Your real list lives in the TARGETS_JSON
repository secret, which is encrypted and never readable from the repo, so
nothing public reveals what you are actually hunting. See README.
watch_listings_after — OPTIONAL ISO8601 UTC cutoff, and normally omitted.
Listings flaired Sold are already filtered out, so
age is not usually the thing you care about — set
this only if you also want a hard date floor.
refs                 — reference numbers. Matched loosely: spaces, dots and
'xy7788' all hit, and a longer ref that starts with
aliases              — nicknames sellers use INSTEAD of the reference. Keep
these specific: a model nickname is safe, a bare
brand name would alert on everything that brand lists.
